sample: English GDELT GEG entities on 2016-11-14 only. 238,212,204 bytes. One day is not a full-span rate.
rule: A mention matches a node only when wikipediaUrl, with the host and scheme ignored and spaces read as underscores, equals that node's English Wikipedia title. If wikipediaUrl is empty and mid equals a mid listed for that same title below, the mid matches. A bare name never matches. If the URL is present and is a different title, the mid cannot override it. If both the URL and the mid are empty, the mention is dropped. One article still counts once per node.

SNAP.note: The bare name Snap on the sample day pointed at gridiron football, SNAP benefits, and a horse. None of those rows are the company.

sample_name_rows_that_the_rule_drops.Apple: 23 of 1,900 name rows point at Apple, Apple (the disambiguation or fruit page), or Apple (album), not Apple Inc.
sample_name_rows_that_the_rule_drops.Windows: 8 of 279 name rows are the page Window or have no URL and no allowed mid.
sample_name_rows_that_the_rule_drops.Azure: 13 of 29 name rows are heraldry, a color, Bentley Azure, or have no URL.
sample_name_rows_that_the_rule_drops.Android: 1 of 829 name rows has no URL.
sample_name_rows_that_the_rule_drops.Model S: 5 of 25 name rows have no URL. No other Wikipedia title appeared.
sample_name_rows_that_the_rule_drops.Amazon: 32 of 1,077 name rows point at the river, the rainforest, the basin, or Amazon Web Services.
sample_name_rows_that_the_rule_drops.HP: 75 of 164 rows for the bare name HP point at horsepower, HP Sauce, Himachal Pradesh, or Harry Potter. The study node does not use that bare name.
sample_name_rows_that_the_rule_drops.Snap: 0 of 18 bare-name rows point at Snapchat.
sample_name_rows_that_the_rule_drops.Meta: 3 of 3 rows on this 2016 day have no URL. The node keeps the Facebook title from the DBpedia map.

full_span_audit.span: 2016-11-14 through the last stored article slice, 2026-06-15
full_span_audit.denominator: An entity mention is in a node's audit denominator when its Wikipedia title is that node's logged title, or when its mid is listed for that node.
full_span_audit.numerator: The title equals the logged title.
full_span_audit.empty_url: A mid match with an empty title is counted apart from the right-page share and was assigned.
full_span_audit.not_assigned: A present title that is not the logged title was not assigned, including when the mid is listed for the node.
full_span_audit.amazon_mid: /m/0mgkg is not a clean pointer to Amazon.com. Of 4,932,387 audit mentions, 395,164 have wiki Amazon.com, 3,673 have an empty title, and 4,533,550 have another title. 4,481,725 of those are Amazon_(company).
full_span_audit.meta: The logged title Facebook has 0 rows. Meta_Platforms has 738,060 documents and was not assigned.
full_span_audit.bare_names: Bare-name mistakes cannot be measured in this extract. The stored rows are title and mid only.
